episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: While the police commissioner investigates a clue left at the site of a robbery, the three members of the Green Glove Gang go into hiding.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Officer Gujska searches for the owner of the tattoo. Zuzanna befriends her fellow residents and helps Josef with his sister`s funeral.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The gang decides to teach the greedy funeral home director a lesson. The police track down the gateway car belonging to the suspects.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Kinga, Alicja and Zuzanna plan a heist to reclaim stolen possessions from a pawn shop. A witness comes forward with information that threatens the gang.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A gang of thieves steals a meteorite, leaving behind a green glove. Kinga, Alicja and Zuzanna decide to intervene when they discover Marzena`s plot.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The Green Glove Gang tries to expose a famous healer defrauding the community. The Police reach out to the public for help with the case.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Marzena goes to the police and snitches on Kinga, Alicja and Zuzanna. Officer Gujska sends an undercover operative to buy the meteorite.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Igor comes forward to help the commissioner. The nursing home residents work together to try and take down Marzena and her criminal enterprise.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When the life of Zuzanna's son is threatened by a ruthless mob boss, the Green Glove Gang is left with only one choice: planning an impossible heist.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Frustrated with the police commissioner, Gujska follows a lead on her own. The gang conducts reconnaissance for the heist with the help of Tomek.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The gang recruits a mysterious demolitions expert to help them infiltrate the art gallery. Marzena makes a deal for her release.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Zuzanna and Kinga ignore Alicja's premonitions and take down a corrupt dog shelter owner. The senior nightclub attracts unwanted attention.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Alicja stands up to Masarz. After a fruitless interrogation, Gujska plots to trick the police commissioner. Marzena sets a trap for the gang.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Tomek receives a tempting offer. Kinga suffers a bout of jealousy. Masarz decides to take out Alicja — on an extravagant date.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A familiar face shows up at the nightclub. When the gang discovers what Masarz is really after, they are forced to launch the heist early.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Kinga, Alicja and Zuzanna scramble to stay one step ahead of multiple gangsters, an informant, the entire police force — and each other.
